from_notes: Although many states existed during this period, only Koshala and Magadha emerged as powerful.
from_notes_src: PMF Ancient & Medieval Part 2 (src/indian-history/pmf-ancient-medieval-02.txt) p.24, p.27
x: Magadha became the most powerful of the sixteen Mahajanapadas, absorbing Kosala, Avanti, Vatsa and the rest under the Haryankas, Shishunagas and Nandas. Of the printed options, Kosala and Avanti were Magadha's main rivals but lost out to it; Kambhoja and Vatsa were minor.
